HajduSaradha2012.scope: Original uses h for primorial and H for arbitrary sets. H24=236>h24=234;equalthrough23. CRT translates arbitrary covering classes into consecutive noncoprime integers. These are old finite results,not new-source numerical validation.

CostelloWatts2015.locator: UCD author version,PDFpp2-3(printedpp1-2),Introduction and recurrent pi_min lower-bound interface
CostelloWatts2015.scope: Algorithm concerns first k primes/primorial. Computes explicit bounds through10000;old computation reports h49 bound within3times742. It does not give arbitrary prime-set extremal bounds;unknown asymptotic constant and explicit finite computation are distinguished.

BanksFordTao2023.scope: J(w) is prime-cutoff gap;Section2.3 deletes classes beyond sqrt(y/logy) from an interval-sieve lower bound. Section2.4 connects a stronger normalized lower bound to exceptional zeros;conditional model statements are not unconditional prime guarantees.

Ziller2019.scope: Original reports exhaustive maximum Jacobsthal computations through k43,including primorial/arbitrary differences and balanced-cover ancillary data. This project read reported scope only;no reproduction of enumeration or ancillary completeness.

Sofos2023.scope: Nonnegative weights,0<=g(p)<1 and dimension-product condition imply fundamental sieve main with relative O(e^-s) plus unweighted squarefree remainder. F021 uses a weaker divisor-weighted remainder. This selected classical input is not audited proof of all F021 uses.

Lichtman2022.scope: Complete Kloosterman sum bound tau(c)sqrt(c*gcd(m,n,c)),arbitrary frequencies and modulus;gcd factor is essential and is retained in F021 hyperbola completion. Prior source cites IK Cor11.12,full original dependency not checked.
